subject.title: feat: expose readable session presentation metadata

question: Should `sessions.list.presentation` permanently expose this 20-family taxonomy and title-source precedence as the shared cross-client contract?
rationale: The implementation is additive, but selecting stable semantic categories and fallback expectations is a product/API commitment that code review cannot safely infer.

options.title: Approve and harden the contract
options.body: Keep the Gateway projection, document that the object is optional and classifications are extensible, require unknown/absent fallbacks in coordinated clients, and remove the changelog edit.

options.title: Narrow the first contract
options.body: Expose only readable title, subtitle, and main/background state now, deferring the detailed family taxonomy until multiple clients establish the required categories.

options.title: Pause the protocol surface
options.body: Keep existing client-side presentation logic until maintainers are ready to own a stable shared taxonomy across all session producers.

recommendation.title: Approve and harden the contract
recommendation.body: Keep the Gateway projection, document that the object is optional and classifications are extensible, require unknown/absent fallbacks in coordinated clients, and remove the changelog edit.
